prefsFloor.restIntervalRule: harvestAndFeed (and harvestAndRest with useHpBasedRest=false, which the floor forbids): restInterval >= min(30000, ceil(farmInterval * 51 / 100))
prefsFloor.failsafeRestRule: harvestAndFeed with failsafe on (forced): failsafeRestDuration >= min(72000, max(3600, restInterval))
prefsFloor.hpRule: useHpBasedRest forced on; hpThresholdLow >= 45; hpThresholdHigh >= min(100, hpThresholdLow + 5)

actionsPerDay.formula: rest_v3: cycle = REST_V3_MEASURED_CYCLE_SEC, else cycle = max(60,farm)+max(60,rest); actions = ceil(86400/cycle)*2 + 4; non-rest_v3 adds ceil(86400/collect) + ceil(86400/scavenge) for intervals > 0; harvestAndFeed with a feed timer adds ceil(86400/feedInterval). Computed on FLOORED prefs.

feePerGasFormula.eip1559: max(2 * baseFeePerGas + maxPriorityFeePerGas, gasPrice); maxPriorityFeePerGas = eth_maxPriorityFeePerGas or 1 gwei when the RPC returns none; no base fee -> gasPrice

gas.billedActionGasFormula: units + floor(units / 10)  (Yominet charges 10% of unused gas)
gas.exitRule: ACTIVE lease: strategy stopped when operatorBalance + escrow < exitStopTriggerActions * billedActionWei; restarted at >= exitResumeActions * billedActionWei
gas.setupAndHubRule: price setupGasWei and hubGasWei at the same billed feePerGas

reservations.reserveBody: { market, factory, nonce, renter, tokenIndex, fundingWei }  (tokenIndex optional but should be sent; fundingWei optional decimal string = setupGasWei + hubGasWei + operatingGasWei of the priced quote, should be sent)
reservations.attestBody: { market, factory, quote }  (quote.renter and quote.tokenIndex required; with requireRenterBalance quote.setupGasWei, hubGasWei and operatingGasWei are required)
reservations.releaseBody: { market, factory, nonce, renter }  -> 200 { released: boolean }; idempotent; answered even while the worker is stale or halted
reservations.releaseRule: send when the renter closes or cancels checkout or the wallet rejects the tx: the reservation stops blocking the listing and the renter's open-checkout count and never starts a cooldown; an attested quote still counts toward the lease caps until its deadline (it can still be submitted)
reservations.refusal429Body: { error, code: LEASE_CAP | RESERVATION_CAP | LISTING_COOLDOWN, scope }

refusalScopes.reservation: RESERVATION_CAP: this wallet has maxReservationsPerRenter open checkouts, or started maxReservationAttemptsPerRenter reservations within reservationTtlSec
refusalScopes.renter: RESERVATION_CAP: this wallet holds maxActiveLeasesPerRenter leases (active + in checkout)
refusalScopes.lease: RESERVATION_CAP: another renter holds this listing's open checkout (listingSingleCheckout) or the listing has maxReservationsPerListing open checkouts; LISTING_COOLDOWN: this wallet's last checkout for this listing expired unused less than listingReserveCooldownSec ago
refusalScopes.market: LEASE_CAP: market at maxActiveLeases; RESERVATION_CAP: maxLiveReservations checkouts in flight

reservations.retryAfterRule: scope lease refusals from listingSingleCheckout and LISTING_COOLDOWN carry a Retry-After header (seconds until the other checkout stops holding / the cooldown ends); every 503 carries Retry-After: 60
reservations.renterBalanceRule: attest: renter ETH balance (latest block) >= quote setupGasWei + hubGasWei + operatingGasWei; reserve: >= fundingWei when sent. RPC failure fails closed (503 BALANCE_UNAVAILABLE). An INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE attest releases the unattested reservation.
reservations.insufficientBalanceBody: 403 { error, code: INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, scope: renter, requiredWei }
reservations.listingSingleCheckoutRule: at reserve (tokenIndex sent): refused when ANOTHER renter holds an open checkout for the listing: not released, and unattested inside reservationTtlSec or attested with its quote deadline ahead; the same renter may re-quote
reservations.listingReserveCooldownRule: at reserve (tokenIndex sent): after one of this renter's checkouts for the listing stopped holding (TTL / quote deadline) without a pod and without a release, the renter cannot reserve that listing for listingReserveCooldownSec

rules: trim; strip one pair of matching surrounding quotes; trim
split on ','; trim entries; skip empty entries
each entry: 0x + 40 hex digits, any case (no checksum check), else hard error at startup
non-empty value without any address -> hard error
